package rulefixtures

// scenario for full_dataset_load: Calls that load an entire payload into memory instead of streaming.
// fixture polarity: negative; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario498Negative(chunks [][]byte) int {
	total := 0
	for _, chunk := range chunks {
		// Process already-streamed chunks incrementally.
		total += len(chunk)
	}
	return total
}
